ModMetadata.Name: Fail-Closed Blast Doors
ModMetadata.Author: erica-kretsch
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Fail-Closed Blast Doors[/h1]
A blast door is for containment, not traffic. With this mod it closes by itself when it loses power, using a hydraulic accumulator that opening the door charges.
[h2]How it works[/h2] [list] [*]A powered blast door takes 10 seconds to open. As it opens it compresses its accumulator, so a fully open door is armed. Closing is as fast as vanilla. [*]If the door loses power while it holds enough stored energy to travel back to closed, it closes. A partly open door still has enough. [*]A door opened by crowbar while unpowered opens at vanilla speed, but that diverts the hydraulics: it stays open on power loss and has to recharge once power returns. [*]An open door that has not recharged refuses a close command: its [b]Error[/b] logic value goes to 1 and its [b]Setting[/b] reads 0. When the accumulator can cover the distance, the door closes. [*]While an open door recharges, its status light shows a different colour. [/list]
Only the Blast Door is changed. Airlocks, hangar doors and every other door behave as before.
[h2]Multiplayer[/h2] Install it on the server and on every player. The host runs the accumulator, so a player without the mod still sees doors close on power loss, but sees them open at normal speed, out of step with the host.
[h2]Support[/h2] Report a bug or ask for a change on GitHub: https://github.com/erica-kretsch/fail-closed-blast-doors/issues
[h2]For modders[/h2] Other mods can register their own blast door prefabs, and read whether a door is opening, recharging, closing or in standby, through a small static API.
This is a [b]StationeersLaunchPad[/b] plugin mod. It requires BepInEx. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
<size="26"><color=#ffa500>Blast doors close when they lose power.</color></size>
A powered open takes 10 seconds and charges a hydraulic accumulator. A crowbar open skips the charge, so that door stays open on power loss until it recharges.
A close the accumulator cannot cover waits: Error reads 1 and Setting reads 0.
Only the Blast Door changes. Install on the server and on every player: a player without it sees the door open at normal speed, out of step with the host.
Requires BepInEx and StationeersLaunchPad.
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 1.0.0:[/h3] [list] [*]Blast doors close when they lose power, if their hydraulic accumulator holds enough energy to travel back. [*]A powered open takes 10 seconds and charges the accumulator; closing keeps the vanilla speed. [*]A crowbar open skips the charge, so the door stays open on power loss until it recharges. [*]A close the accumulator cannot cover waits: Error reads 1 and Setting reads 0 until it can run. [*]An open door recharges when powered, with a status light colour, and keeps its charge across a save and reload. [*]Other mods can register their own blast door prefabs and read each door's state. [/list]
